label: Electricity (US national average)

source.name: US EPA Greenhouse Gas Equivalencies Calculator (eGRID-based national average)

methodology: EPA's national weighted-average electricity emission rate. This is a US-wide average; actual grid intensity varies significantly by state and utility. Location-specific electricity factors are a planned future enhancement (see /methodology).
